The '''Catacombs''' were [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tombs built in caves on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. During the [[Invasion of Ossus]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] collapsed the caves with explosives to prevent [[Darth Malora]]'s [[Mutated Geonosian]]s to use the tunnels to attack the [[Jedi Colony]].<ref name="TOR:TLC" />
